role: passive receive-only direct-plug ferrite pod for the dedicated non-50-Ohm AMI port

interface.termination: standard-polarity SMA male with centre pin
interface.connector_role_note: SMA is only the mechanical interface; the completed pod is not a 50-Ohm antenna

electrical_design.topology: one unshielded ferrite loop directly between SMA centre and shell; no buffer, selector, transformer or tuning capacitor in the pod

winding.wire: 38-AWG single-build solderable polyurethane magnet wire, NEMA MW 79-C
winding.construction: single layer centred on the rod; initial calculated winding length is approximately 14.2 mm

derived_limits.note: The 29-pF limit is derived from the current AN383 family equation and is an acceptance target, not measured evidence for Si4732-A10.

mechanical_design.orientation: the narrow pod continues outward from the antenna edge and fits between the neighbouring 14-mm connector centrelines
mechanical_design.core_carrier: non-conductive controlled housing; no metal shield around the rod
mechanical_design.copper_keepout: no plane, switching trace or digital circuit under or alongside the rod; the small interface PCB remains at the SMA end
mechanical_design.load_path: housing supports connector torque and bending; coil wire is not structural

paper_alternate.purpose: second buildable geometry for the same passive direct-plug AM/LW role

winding.derivation: setup-only square-root scaling from the first geometry; measured inductance overrides the calculated turn count

connector.termination: SMA male edge mount for 0.062-inch PCB

paper_alternate.substitution_limit: this is not a source-independent alternate because the core remains Fair-Rite material 61 and the winding uses the same Remington wire; qualify it as a separate assembly, including the 153-200-kHz boundary

required_evidence: measure every finished winding at 100 kHz and accept only 285-315 uH
measure standalone self-resonance and complete AMI capacitance budget before receiver HIL
prove AM 520-1710-kHz tuning, sensitivity, overload and enclosure-noise performance on the assembled device
prove LW 153-279-kHz tuning and sensitivity, explicitly including 153-200 kHz below the core maker's suggested 0.2-MHz boundary
prove that the unselected radios, display, storage and power converters enter their quiet states during AM/LW receive
prove ESD, connector torque, bending, repeated mating, drop and orientation-null behaviour
build and qualify L2-ANT-AM-LW-ALT01 independently rather than inferring performance from its calculated starting turn count
qualification.claim_boundary: The assembly identity and constituent first-target MPNs are selected; AM/LW performance is not production-qualified until every required measurement passes.
